access_rule: Read only by rift.evaluate.verify (the independent verifier). rift.repair refuses to open any path under experiments/heldout/. Only the verifier's disposition and aggregate metrics are reported; no per-workload feedback is returned to candidate selection.

families.mechanism: new address permutations mixing crossbar bank conflicts and butterfly first-stage conflicts
response-dependent releases, gaps and warm-up prefixes
same decision question against a radix-2 butterfly (held-out configuration)
representative legal random traffic, equal weights

rules: R1 no MODEL_ERROR or TIMEOUT for the candidate on any held-out workload
R2 strict ranking reversals across the basket: candidate < parent
R3 no regression: no held-out workload on which the parent's choice is correct (zero regret) and the candidate's choice incurs regret beyond the margin
R4 candidate warm cost-only runtime <= 3x the parent's on the basket
R5 every development discovery witness is resolved (no longer a strict reversal)
R6 patch boundary: only the editable design's model specification changes; no workload digests, address literals or benchmark identities in the specification
acceptance_contract.reference_failure_rule: if any held-out reference run is not COMPLETED, the affected workloads are excluded for both parent and candidate and the disposition is INCONCLUSIVE when more than 10% are affected
acceptance_contract.tie_policy: argmin; ties resolved to the first design in the admitted order
